_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be a student. - The applicant must have passed the Class 10th or Class 12th examination. - The applicant must have secured admission in a diploma course, a degree course after diploma, or a degree course after Class 12th. - The applicant must be pursuing medical, dental, engineering, technology, pharmacy, Ayurveda, homeopathy, nursing, physiotherapy, para-medical, or higher education courses. - The applicant must have a family annual income of less than or equal to ₹4,50,000/-.
